channel.title: Nicotine Science and Policy
channel.description: Daily digest of views, debates and discussions on nicotine science, policy, regulation and advocacy.

item.title: Risk Reversal | Why Americans Now Fear Vaping More Than Smoking | RegWatch
item.description: Risk perceptions of vaping in the US have shifted significantly, with 30% of adults now believing e-cigarettes are more harmful than smoking. (Published on October 19, 2026byregulatorwatch.com)

item.title: Swiss youth smoking falls almost a quarter in two years
item.description: Smoking among young people aged 15–24 in Switzerland fell by almost a quarter between 2023 and 2025, while vaping rates remained broadly stable at around 9%. (Published on October 19, 2026byclearingtheair.eu)

item.title: Flaws in Studies of Vaping among Former Smokers
item.description: Comparing former smokers who vape with those who no longer use nicotine may produce misleading conclusions about health risks and smoking relapse. (Published on October 19, 2026bysubstack.com)

item.title: Latin American Survey Finds Widespread Confusion Among Adolescents About Nicotine Pouch Risks
item.description: A survey of nearly 13,000 adolescents across Argentina, Guatemala, Mexico and Peru reveals significant misconceptions about nicotine pouch risks. Almost 39% considered pouches more harmful than cigarettes, while only 2.4% reported using them in the previous month. (Published on October 19, 2026bydaily-pouch.com)
